exposure: Uterine arterial embolization and surgery (UAE + Surg)
Local or systemic methotrexate injection and surgery (MTX + Surg)
outcome: Therapeutic effects of different treatments for cesarean scar pregnancy
cohort: 103 women diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy
finding: Methotrexate injection plus surgery might be the best treatment for CSP patients, as it was associated with lower rates of intraoperative hemorrhage, intrauterine adhesions, and embryo residue compared to uterine arterial embolization plus surgery or surgery alone.
